properties.name: 门德斯考古遗址区（现状标绘）
properties.periodLabel: 多时期现状遗迹标绘；不是完整古城或城墙
properties.enPeriodLabel: Mapped multi-period remains; not city walls

properties.enNote: Original OSM mapped reference; not a surveyed city circuit or complete palace enclosure. The excavation director identifies Mendes as a former capital. Dynasty 29 capital status is distinct from its longer provincial and religious roles. Tell el-Rubʿ is not merged with neighboring Thmuis, and the mapped site area is not the city-wall circuit.

properties.name: 布托遗迹区（现状标绘）
properties.periodLabel: 多时期现状遗迹标绘；不是完整古城或城墙
properties.enPeriodLabel: Mapped multi-period remains; not city walls
properties.note: 原始OSM遗迹区标绘，不代表已确认的全城、城防或宫城。 DAI研究确认第一至第二王朝带行政、经济与仪式功能的王室庄园及宫殿式建筑；这不等同证实布托是独立国家首都。保留传统下埃及王权关联，先按普通古城收录，仍遵循对应时期legend。遗址区和宫殿式建筑范围不得当作全城或已证实皇城。
properties.enNote: Original OSM mapped reference; not a surveyed city circuit or complete palace enclosure. DAI identifies a Dynasty 1–2 royal estate with administrative and economic functions and a palace-like complex. This does not establish an independent national capital. Retain the traditional Lower Egyptian royal association as uncertain and classify as an ordinary ancient city, still controlled by its corresponding period.
